reference_only.why: kept out of effects: random answers almost never pass all three screeners (exact two-of-nine and two-of-six multi-selects and one matrix row: about 1 in 160,000), so the mechanical fuzz cannot compute it; the field att_all is in the units, so a run can compute it (checker request)
as above; also not significant as printed (direction not claimed)

keyed.why: answers that make the scored signs true: Study 1 yes-rates 0.64/0.33 (accuracy, true/false) and 0.50/0.44 (sharing); Study 2 treatment raises sharing of true headlines only; everyone uses Facebook and passes the three screeners (so the attention subsets are the full sample)

answers.headline_s1.judge: 1 if bernoulli((0.64 if h > 15 else 0.33) if cond in (1, 2) else (0.50 if h > 15 else 0.44)) else 0
answers.headline_s2.rate: randint(2, 6) if (cond == 2 and h > 15) else randint(1, 6)
